tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (nya)༄༅/ /ye shes khyung nag gi sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /gser chos/ /༄༅/ /nam mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil pa 'byung
(nya)༄༅/ /ye shes khyung nag gi sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /gser chos/ /༄༅/ /nam mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil pa 'byung

tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// ye shes khyung nag gi sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

gser chos// ༄༅// nam mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil pa 'byung po 'ur 'ded kyi man ngag ces bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las rnams// drag po'i nad gdon gzhom bya'i phyir// 'dab bzang dbang po'i skur sprul pa// rdo rje nam mkha' lding la 'dud// de yi man ngag rno zhing myur// spu gri lta bu'i zhal gdams rnams// mkhas grub bla ma'i gsung ji bzhin// gzhan phyir brtse bas bri bar bya// gdams pa 'di la gnyis te/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ gdams ngag dngos so// dang po ni/ rgya gar gyi bla ma ā tsarya dmar pos/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la dngos su gnang*/ des rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ des rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ des rong mi grags pa dpal/ des rong mi lba ba can sangs rgyas dpal/ des rong mi dar ma grags/ des rong mi sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ des rong mi bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ des shar sbu chu ba dpal ldan grags pa/ des mkhan chen lhun grub dpal/ chos rje nam mkha' legs pa/ chos rje wā gī shwa ra/ des ngag dbang grags pa dpal bzang po la/ des bdag la'o// gnyis pa gdams pa dngos la gsum/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor ro// dang po la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ grub pa'i rtags so// dang po ni/ mtshams grub na rab/ de ma grub kyang yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la bsdad/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was chos thams cad stong par bsgom mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lha bsgom pa dang*/ sngags bzla ba'o// dang po la bzhi/ rang gnam lcags kyi khyung du bskyed pa/ thub pas dbur brgyan pa/ rtsa sngags kyis brtan par bya ba/ changs bu'i gtor ma 'bul ba'o// dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i klong dkyil du/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ de'i steng du wam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po rba rlabs du ma 'khrugs pa las lbu ba'i phung po dpag tu med pa 'khrigs pa/

de dag gcig tu 'dus nas lbu ba'i phung po chen po lam̐ gyis mtshan pa zhig tu gyur/ de rlung gis dkrugs nas yongs su gyur pa las rgya mtsho chen po'i steng du/ sa'i dkyil 'khor gser gyi rang bzhin mig mangs ris su drwa bas sbrel ba gru bzhi pas khyab pa/ de'i steng du nam mkha'i mdog can gyi yi ge kṣiṃ sngon po de las 'od zer sngon po dpag tu med pa 'phros 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab pas/ sems can thams cad kyi klu dang sa bdag la sogs pa'i gnod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul mkhyen brtse dang mthu stobs thams cad 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par bsdus/ yi ge kṣiṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser mig 'khyil pa sku mdog sngon po nam mkha'i mdog can/ rwa dang mchu sder thams cad gnam lcags las grub pa/ spyan gsum nyi ma ltar 'bar zhing 'khyil pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yon pas thugs kar sor mo lnga gdengs pa mthe bong la sogs pa'i sor mo lnga la rim pa bzhin/ oṃ pakṣiṃ swā hā lnga las klu lnga 'dul ba'i khyung dkar po/ dmar po/ sngon po/ ser po/ ljang gu lngas phyag gnyis kyis klu rgyal rigs/ rje'u rigs/ khyab byed rigs ldan dang*/ bram ze'i rigs dang*/ gdol pa dmangs rigs kyi ngo bo sbrul dkar po/ dmar po/ sngon po/ ser po/ ljang gu gnyis gnyis kyi sked pa nas brgyangs nas 'phyar thabs su 'dzin pa/ mgo bo bsnol ma gnyis gnyis zhal du gsol cing*/ mjug ma bsnol ma gnyis zhabs kyis mnan pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs rnams gtso bo lta bu'o// phyag g.yas pas klu'i rgyal po chu bdag sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa stod lha'i lus can/ smad sbrul mjug tu gnas pa thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ nor bu rin po ches brgyan pa'i sked pa nas 'phyar thabs su 'dzin pa/

mjug ma zhabs gnyis kyis mnan pa/ sgro dang spu thung rnams gnam lcags kyi ral gri dang chu gri spu gri'ang zer 'bar bas gtams pa/ lus la rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ rwa bar yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ dbu'i gnas lngar gser gyi 'khor lo lngas brgyan pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhengs pa/ sku las sprul pa'i pho nya dang me'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro bas/ gnod byed gzhob thul thul bsregs pa/ thugs kar yi ge kṣiṃ sngon pos mtshan pa bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ thugs ka'i kṣiṃ las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas shākya thub pa 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ rang nyid kyi spyi gtsug gi 'khor lo'i steng du bzhugs par bsgom/ gsum pa ni/ rang nyid de lta bu'i lha'i nga rgyal brtan par bsams nas rtsa sngags tshar gcig brjod nas byin gyis brlab bo// bzhi pa ni/ rang gi mdun du dngos sam yid kyi zan gyi changs bu gtsang ma lnga tsam yod na sha dum re bcug chu gtsang gis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs kyi byin gyis brlab/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i khyung gsal btab/ rtsa sngags bdun nam gsum gang rung gis 'bul lo// 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ khyung rang la bstim mo// gnyis pa sngags bzla ba ni/ bskyed rim de nyid la dmigs pa gtad de/ oṃ pakṣiṃ rā dza/ bya'i rgyal po/ na mo ga ru ḍa/ nam mkha' lding*/ e bha sarba nā ga bha ya ka ra/ klu thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ sarba bi sa na hūm̐ phaṭa/ thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ kṣiṃ pa oṃ swā hā/ oṃ pakṣiṃ swā hā/ pakṣiṃ oṃ swā hā/ swā pa oṃ hā kṣiṃ/ hā pa oṃ swā kṣiṃ/ zhes pa'i rtsa sngags 'di mi'i tshig gis bar ma chod par byas la 'bum phrag gsum bzlas pas las thams cad 'grub par the tshom med do// gsum pa grub pa'i rtags la gsum/ phyi rtags/ nang rtags/

gsang ba'i rtags so// dang po ni/ dngos sam rmi lam du rang khyung du gyur nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba/ sbal sbrul/ lcong mo/ sdig pa/ sdom/ rta la sogs pa'i 'bu srin dang sems can zos pa/ mer bsregs pa/ lus las bud pa/ mtsho dang chu klung dang*/ chu mig skam pa la sogs pa rmi'o// gnyis pa ni/ gnyid chung ba dang*/ lus yang ba dang*/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang 'phur ba snyam pa la sogs rmi ba'o// gsum pa ni/ nad dang gdon drag po la sogs pa 'dul ba na/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gsal zhing brtan la 'di dag 'dul ba la the tshom med snyam pa'i gdengs dang mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa bskyed pa'o// gnyis pa sgrub pa la gnyis/ sgom bzlas dang*/ dam tshig bsrung ba'o// dang po ni/ rang nyid nam mkha' lding du bskyed pa sogs dang*/ gtor ma 'bul ba rnams bsnyen pa ji lta ba bzhin bya/ de nas rang gi mgo bo'i oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi sku lus las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bo khyung dkar po dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa oṃ la thim pas mgo'i nang sku'i khyung dkar po sor mo la bkod pa lta bu gcig bsgoms nas rtsa sngags kyi hūm̐ phaṭa yan 'dra ba la/ oṃ dang*/ pa dang*/ kṣiṃ dang*/ swā dang*/ hā ste/ yig 'bru lngas mgo drangs pa'i khyung rigs lnga'i sngags btags pa khri phrag gcig bzla'o// de bzhin du mgrin pa la kṣiṃ dmar po zhig bsgom nas/ pa oṃ kṣiṃ swā hā/ lngas sna drangs pas sngags lnga btags pa khri bzla/ thugs kar kṣiṃ sngon po zhig bsgoms nas/ rtsa sngags ji lta ba bzhin te/ kṣiṃ oṃ pa swā hā lnga pos mgo drangs pa'i sngags lnga btags la khri bzla/ lte bar swā las khyung ser po zhig bsgoms nas swā dang*/ oṃ dang*/ pa dang*/ kṣiṃ dang*/ hā ste lngas mgo drangs pa'i sngags lnga po khri bzla/

gsang gnas su khyad par lha las 'od zer 'phros 'jig rten gyi khams kyi snod bcud/ dug sman gyi nus mthu bcud thams cad dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu yon tan 'phris las thams cad bsdus nas hā la thim pas phrin las kyi khyung ljang gur bsgom ste/ hā dang*/ oṃ dang*/ pa dang*/ kṣiṃ dang*/ swā ste yig 'bru lngas mgo drangs pa'i sngags tshan lnga rim pa bzhin btags la khri tsho bzhi bzla'o// de ltar sgrub pa la khri tsho lnga bzlas pas las rab 'byams dang nad gdon gang la yang thogs pa med do// nad gdon thams cad 'dul ba la gdeng thob pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ bya sha bya'i sgo nga*/ la phug za tshod rnams man ngag byed pa'i dus su thams cad spangs na rab/ tha na'ang sgrub pa byed pa'i dus su thams cad spangs te mtshams shin tu bsdams la smra ba bcad nas 'bad pa gal che'o// gsum pa las sbyor la gnyis/ khyad par gyi las sbyor dang*/ spyi 'gro'i las sbyor ro// dang po la dgu las ser ba dang*/ char bcad pa ni/ yungs kar/ gri thal/ mtsho chen po'i bye ma dang gsum la rtsa sngags stong phrag gdab/ dang pos ser ba dang*/ char pa dang*/ rlung chen po dang*/ thog la sogs pa 'bab pa'i dus su bsnyen pa bzhin rang khyung du bsgom/ de la sdigs mdzub gtad/ rtsa sngags drag tu bzla/ rdzas gsum gtor/ phus btab pas char chad pa the tshom med do// gnyis pa mid 'byar chos par 'dod na/ rgyam tshwa rnyed na rab/ ma rnyed na tshwa bzang po gang rung gang 'os dang*/ nas 'bru gsum dang bcas pa sla ngar brngos nas yos su song ba dang grang du bcug ste/ sgang bur blug 'khar ba'am/ zangs sam/ smyug ma'am/ lcags sbubs su bcug skud pas bcing*/ rtsa sngags stong phrag gcig gdab/ de nam dgos dus su lto stong la khem bde re'am/ phyed tsam re lto tshod dang bstun nas chu bskol pa la sogs pas phul nas gtang ngo*// de bzhin byas pas sha dug

ma zhu ba/ pho nad/ rgyu nad/ sbos pa/ skran/ grol ma la sogs pa nang cha'i nad thams cad la thengs pas chog go /gsum pa dug srung ba la/ a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba'am/ gdong drug gam/ gser mdog bzang po zhib par btags/ ril bu sran ma 'bring tsam gang dgos bya/ ril bu'i grangs kyi rtsa sngags stong tsho re gdab/ lto stong la ril bur zos pas zla ba re srung thub/ 'di dug srung dang gso ba gnyis ka yin/ bzhi pa dug gi 'dred la/ dpyid ka sa 'og gi zwa'i myu gu dkar po gtsang ma bre gang tsam la gla rtsi bzang po ri bong ril ma tsam zhig gdab/ rlon brdung byas la grib skam bya/ zhib par btags la dge slong ngam byis pa lo brgyad pa'i dri chus sbru/ ril bu sran ma 'bring po tsam bya/ rtsa sngags ril bu'i grangs sam stong phrag gcig gdab/ lto stong la re re zos pas dug byung dus su khong du song ma thag skyugs yong*/ sngar song ba'i dug ro rnying pa yin rung thams cad skyugs 'ong zla ba re la re res chog 'di dug brtag pa/ dug srung ba/ 'dred gso ba thams cad la 'gro ba yin no// lnga pa sri'u gso na/ bal nag gi skud pa khru gsum sum bsgril la/ sor bzhi bzhi'i sar mdud pa re re ste lnga byas/ mdud pa re re la khyung re re ste lnga bsgom/ rtsa sngags bsnyen grangs sam stong phrag gcig gdab/ de gang bsrung ba'i bu tsha'i ske la btags so// 'di'i srung skud ci tsam btags pa'i rta phyugs ra lug la sogs kyi phru gu ma sos pa rnams dang*/ bang mdzod la 'dre zhugs pa dang*/ sna khrag dang*/ thig le ma chod pa dang*/ zho nyes/ chang nyes rnams la snga ma bzhin byas nas srung skud btags pas thub par the tshom med do// drug pa gdon bgegs skrod par 'dod na/ btsan dug nag po/ gu gul nag po/ shu dag nag po/ mu zi nag po/ gla rtsi/ shing kun/ ldong ros/ ba bla/ pho rog gi mgo/ nya spre ba'i mgo/ sha chen/ tshil chen/ sre mong gi sha

spre'u'i sha rwa gzhob/ spyang khu'i brun/ seng lding*/ tsandan/ 'dzin pa/ ra dug sa/ ra ru/ glang ru/ rta rmig gsum bsregs pa'i gzhob/ rdo dreg phag tshil/ dri chen/ de rnams sbyar ba la rtsa sngags stong phrag gcig dang*/ nad pa 'dre can gyi 'gab la bdug gam/ byug gam/ btags kyang rung ste gnod par byed pa'i 'dre gdon rnams kyis de dag nam mkha' lding gi rgyal por mthong nas/ de'i nye 'khor dang phyogs su'ang nye bar mi nus shing so sor byer zhing 'bros par 'gyur ro// bdun pa smyo ba 'dul ba la gnyis/ gang gnod brtag pa dang*/ de bcos pa'o// dang po ni/ sems nyams na a wa dhū tir gdon zhugs pa ste/ mig nam mkha' la lta zhing 'bod kyin 'dug na rgyal po yin/ ngu 'bod byed kyin 'dug na ma mo dang srin mo yin/ skad ngan 'don kyin 'dug na 'gong po yin/ lag pa thal mo sbyar nas 'dzum mu le 'dug na byad sdig yin/ breng breng du ngu zhing dngangs pa 'dug na the'u rang yin/ snying mi dga' zhing 'dug na snying 'chus yin/ rna ba na yin 'dug na srin nad yin/ drag la thung na las dbang dang rnam smin yin no// gnyis pa ni/ de dag gang yin yang rung ste/ sha chen/ tshil chen/ mu zi/ gu gul nag po/ sbru ma nag po/ sgog skya/ mi lud/ khyi lud rnams sbyar te phye ma'am ril bu byas te bcang*/ rtsa sngags stong tsho gcig gdab/ rang khyung du bsgom/ nad pa'i snying gar sdigs mdzub gtad/ gdong du rtsa sngags bgrangs la drag tu brdeg nad pa'i srin mdzub srad bu nag pos bcing*/ rdzas kyi dud pas sna bug nas bdug der khos mi bzod par skad ngan 'don/ de dus kho la ming dris/ smras na mna' bsgag go /des sangs khyer du 'gro'o// brgyad pa 'byung ba lnga'i dwangs ma'i bcud len la gsum/ ril bu bya ba/ sngags gdab pa/ bsten pa'i thabs so// dang po ni sa'i dwangs ma bong nga nag po/ chu'i dwangs ma dngul chu/ me'i dwangs ma mu zi dmar po/

rlung gi dwangs ma dha du ra/ nam mkha'i dwangs ma skyu ru ra ste/ rtsa ba'i sman sna lnga cha mnyam/ a ru ra gdong lnga'am/ gser mdog gang rung*/ shu dag nag po/ sha pho ru rta ste yan lag gi sman gsum cha mnyam/ rtsa ba'i sum cha yan lag la'ang bya/ so sor btag rdo gzhong du dngul chu blug de la mu zi nag po gdab/ zhib par btag de nas gzhan rnams kyang der blug cing zhib par btag byis pa lo brgyad pa'i dri chus bsgril/ ril bu bra ril tsam mang du bya/ mtshal gyi na bza' bskon pa byung na bzang*/ ma grub kyang nyes pa med/ de par bu la sogs pa'i snod gtsang mar blug bud med dag gis mi reg pa dang*/ mis mi mthong ba'i sar bzhag go /gnyis pa la gnyis/ sgom bzlas dang grub pa'i rtags so// dang po ni/ mtshams bsdam/ rang khyung du bsgom/ smra ba bcad/ rtsa sngags zhag bdun bzlas te ril bu la btab/ btab/ gnyis pa la rtags dngos dang*/ rmi rtags so// dang po ni/ chu gtsang phor gang tsam la tshad de/ steng du bzhag na steng du sdod/ 'og tu bzhag na 'og tu sdod pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ gong gi gzhung du bshad pa rnams so// gsum pa rten bca' thabs la gnyis/ rang gi za ba dang*/ gzhan la sbyin pa'o// dang po ni/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i ril bu de nangs ma re la rang gis re re zos na rang srung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur te/ sngar yod kyi nad gdon thams cad sos pa dang*/ phyin chad kyi dug rigs nad rims gdon bgegs thams cad las thar zhing*/ lus gso ba'i bcud len gyi mchog tu 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ de nyid sman lto dang bstun nas re re'am/ gsum gsum mam/ lnga'am bdun te sbrum ma dang*/ rma gsar tshab chen ma yin pa'i nad gdon thams cad la thengs pas chog go /de gnyis la'ang gtong dgos byung na tshod zin par byas la btang*/ ril bu ji ltar mang yang bdun yan chad las mi dgos/ rang gzhan gnyis ka la ril bu'i rgyab chos su 'di'i sgom bzlas ma chags tsam re byung na bzang*/

ma lcogs kyang nyes pa med do// dgu pa mdze nad gso ba la gnyis/ brtag pa dang*/ bcos pa'o// dang po la gsum/ g.yan pa'i rtags/ me dbal gyi rtags/ 'brum bu'i rtags so// dang po ni/ mi 'gyur bar gnas pa ste/ khab btsugs kyang mi tshor ba'i sha ro la sogs pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ kha dog dmar po la sogs pa khol bur 'byung ba dang*/ skrangs pa dang*/ sha 'gul ba dang*/ sha mdog 'gyur ba dang*/ bas bldags pa la sogs pa'o// gsum pa ni/ chu bur dang*/ shu 'brum dang*/ rma 'bras la sogs pa ste nang du mdze nad byung ba'i rtags su/ phyi ru de ltar 'byung ste go sla'o// gnyis pa bcos pa la gnyis/ rdzas bsten pa dang*/ sgom bzlas bya ba'o// dang po ni/ stag spre'u/ dred/ gla ba bzhi'i spu dang*/ brun gang rnyed sla ngar spungs pa la steng du rdza phor ram/ lcags phur lta bu kha sbub mtha' 'dag zhal byas te du ba mi 'chor bar bya/ 'og nas me bus te legs par bsregs pa'i thal ba dang*/ yungs kar btab pa rlangs tshos par byas pa bsdoms la bsres/ zhib par btag mi'am rmig pa gcig pa'i tshil bus ril bu pra ril tsam dang*/ lde gu mang du bya/ rtsa sngags dang 'brel pa'i 'og gi sngags ci 'grub gdab/ khe du ril bu btang zhing phyir byugs par byas na/ sha 'gul/ sha khra/ sha khol/ chu bur/ 'brum bu/ bas bldags/ skrangs/ skran/ rma 'bras shu ba nad rims/ gnod bgegs thams cad sangs khyer du 'gro'o// gnyis pa ni/ dben par mtshams bsdam/ rang khyung du bsgom/ smra bcad bya/ rtsa sngags la/ kā la rakṣa rbad rbad/ sod sod/ phyung phyung*/ shig shig spu gris zung zung*/ lcags kyi sder mos gnod byed 'byung po'i snying la zung zung*/ nā ga byer ya sod/ nā ga bye ma ling sod/ ces pa btags la rtsa ba'i sngags slar drag tu song song bsgrub cing bzla'o// sgrub rdzas sngags gnyis ka sbrel na mchog tu bzang*/ de ltar byas pas mdze nad la sogs pa'i nad gdon thams cad la the tshom med do// spyir 'di la khyad par can gyi las tshogs sum cu rtsa gnyis yod na'ang*/

de dag thams cad kyi rdzas dang*/ byed thabs rnams de dag gi de tsam las ma dran yang cher mi lto ste/ gong 'og gi man ngag 'di dag tu de dag gi don ma lus pa 'dus pa nyid yin gsung*/ gsum pa spyi 'gro'i las sbyor ni/ gza' nad/ mdze nad/ klu nad/ gnyan nad/ gdon nad/ dug nad/ yams nad/ rims nad/ 'go nad/ gcong

lhog nad nad/ gag pa/ dreg 'brum bu/ sha ro/ sha 'gul/ bas bldags/ g.yan pa/ skrangs/ skran/ skya rbab/ 'bras/ shu ba/ rma gsar/ gcan gzan/ khyi smyon/ sbal sbrul/ sdig pa/ sre mong*/ sdom/ 'bu srin gyis so btab pa/ mdzo rta'i rgyab chad pa/ phol mig me dbal/ gzhang 'brum/ khyi 'brum/ gos 'brum/ 'brum pa dkar nag dmar sib/ rgya rdo/ rgya nad/ tshad pa/ long ba/ bdun drug cham pa/ bal nad/ dmu chu/ sha ser/ mig ser/ rgyal po/ btsan/ the'u rang*/ pho 'dre/ gnas khang mkhar dang bang mdzod la 'dre zhugs pa/ rta phyugs la 'dre zhugs pa/ sri'u/ be'u la gnod pa dang*/ phyugs kyi glo dang*/ gor dang*/ kha tsha/ ra lug gi 'gab nad rdo dang*/ 'brum pa la sogs pa dang*/ srin po dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma ste mdor na gdon gyi rigs gang yin pa thams cad la rab rang rang la phan pa'i rdzas dang*/ sman rnyed na de dag gi sbyor ba gzhan dang mthun par bya khyung gi bsgom bzlas byas/ rdzas sman la sngags btab/ de byas na mchog tu bzang*/ ma rnyed na'ang lha bsgom/ sngags bzla/ chu gtsang dang na sar sngags btab/ sngags chu sbyin/ des phan par the tshom med do// de ltar bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas nyams su blangs pas gnas skabs su gdon gyi gnod pa thams cad las thar zhing*/ mthar thugs sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur ba'o// gser mig man ngag ye shes chen po// nyams len 'thor rlung chen pos bskul nas// dug gsum 'byung po'i tsher skam ri bo// skad cig nyid la thal bar rlog nges// gnam lcags khyung nag man ngag gser gyi char// 'gro tshogs zhing sa'i phun tshogs dpal bskyed phyir// bla ma'i thugs rje'i sprin phung 'khrigs pa las// dpal ldan grags pa klu dbang bdag gis phab// rdo rje nam mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil pa 'byung po 'ur 'ded kyi man ngag snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa chos rje sa skya pa yab sras kyi bcud len dam par gyur pa/

bla ma dam pa'i gsung la ji ltar byon pa bzhin du shar sbu chu ba dpal ldan grags pas ma sbas par gsal por yi ger bkod pa re zhig rdzogs so// ༈ /gnam lcags khyung nag nam mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gsal ba'i sgron me bzhugs/ na mo gu ru badzra ga ru ḍā ya/ 'dir khyung nag gi rjes gnang bya tshul gyi cho ga la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po gnas dben par maṇḍa lar dri bzang gis thig le byas te/ 'bras sogs kyi tshom bu gnyis bkod pa'i mthar/ dbang ldan du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod phyogs mtshams su bshams pa'i mdun du changs bu lnga'am zlum gtor gcig bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril me tog sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bya'o// gnyis pa ni slob dpon gyis mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya bya zhing*/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe swā hā/ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badzra shabda swā hā/ mthar rol mo dkrol te/ oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi sogs lan gsum gyis byin dbab bo// bdag dang 'gro ba sogs kyis skyabs 'gro ci nus dang*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje nam mkha' lding gi sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was chos thams cad stong par bsgom/

stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i dkyil du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ de'i steng du waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po rba rlabs du ma 'khrugs pa las lbu ba'i phung po dpag tu med pa 'khrigs pa de dag gcig tu bsdus pa las lbu ba'i phung po chen po lam̐ gyis mtshan pa gcig tu gyur/ de rlung gis dkrugs nas yongs su gyur pa las/ rgya mtsho chen po'i steng du sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin gser gyi mig mangs ris kyi drwa ba gru bzhi pas sbrel ba/ de'i steng du nam mkha'i mdog can gyi yi ge kṣiṃ sngon po/ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ sems can thams cad kyi klu dang sa bdag la sogs pa'i gnod pa thams cad gzhob thul gyis bsregs nas/ zhes kyang 'dug zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ mkhyen brtse dang nus stobs thams cad 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par bsdus/ yi ge kṣiṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser mig 'khyil pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ phyag g.yon pas thugs kar sor mo lnga gdengs pa'i mthe bong la sogs pa'i sor mo lnga la rim pa bzhin/ oṃ pakṣiṃ swā hā las klu lnga 'dul ba'i khyung dkar po/ dmar po/ sngon po/ ser po/ ljang gu ste lngas klu rgyal rigs/ rje'u'i rigs/ khyab byed rigs ldan/ bram ze'i rigs/ gdol pa/ dmangs rigs kyi ngo bo sbrul dkar po/ dmar po/ sngon po/ ser po/ ljang gu gnyis gnyis kyi sked pa nas bcangs te 'phyar thabs su 'dzin pa/ mgo bo bsnol ma gnyis gnyis zhal du gsol zhing*/ mjug ma bsnol ma gnyis zhabs kyis mnan pa/ sku mdog sngon po nam mkha'i mdog can/ rwa dang mchu sder thams cad gnam lcags las grub pa/ spyan gsum nyi ma ltar 'bar zhing 'khyil pa/ phyag g.yas klu yi rgyal po chu bdag sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

stod lha'i lus can smad sbrul mjug tu gnas pa/ thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ nor bu rin po ches brgyan pa'i sked pa nas 'phyar thabs su 'dzin pa/ mjug ma zhabs gnyis kyis mnan pa/ sgro dang spu thung thams cad gnam lcags kyi ral gri dang spu gri 'bar bas gtams pa/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan dang rwa bar na yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ dbu'i gnas lngar gser gyi 'khor lo lngas brgyan pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhengs pa/ sku las sprul pa'i pho nya dang sprul pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro bas gnod byed thams cad gzhob thu lu lu bsregs pa/ thugs kar yi ge kṣiṃ sngon pos mtshan par bsgom/ thugs ka'i kṣiṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas thub pa 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i steng du bzhugs pa gyur par bsgom/ rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal brtan par bsgoms nas/ rtsa sngags tshar gcig brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i khyung gsal btab la/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i cho gas dngos sam yid kyis changs bu 'bul/ sngags bzla ba ni/ bskyed rim nyid la dmigs pa gtad de/ oṃ pakṣiṃ rā dza na mo ga ru ḍā/ e bha sarba nā ga bha ya ka ra/ sarba bi sa na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pakṣiṃ swā hā/ pakṣiṃ oṃ swā hā/ kṣiṃ pa oṃ swā hā/ swā pa oṃ hā kṣiṃ/ hā pa oṃ swā kṣiṃ/ 'di'i bsnyen pa byed na 'bum phrag gsum bzla'o// zhes mi tshig gis bar ma chod par ci nus bzlas la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdo rje khyung gi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab ste bsngo smon bya'o// bdag bskyed rkyang pa nyams su len na skyabs 'gro nas 'di'i bar bya'o// mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/

tshom bu bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i dkyil du sogs nas/ spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i steng du bzhugs par gyur/ bdag mdun gyi khyad par tsam ma gtogs sgrub thabs ltar bskyed/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab/ 'dir dharmā ra ṇi mi dgos/ de nas pakṣiṃ rā dza re re 'gor sbyar ba'i arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar dang*/ dharmā ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul mkha' lding khyod// kha dog lnga yi khyung sprul byed// bdud tshogs kun 'joms 'dod pa sgrub// dngos grub kun stsol khyod phyag 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ changs bu chu gtsang gis bran/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlabs la/ rtsa sngags bdun nam gsum gang rung gis phul/ oṃ pakṣiṃ rā dza lan gcig sngon du 'gro ba'i arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal ba'i sogs kyis bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ khyad par du yang klu gnyan sa bdag la sogs pa'i nad gdon nyer 'tshe thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa ci nus byas la gsol ba btab bo/ rmor chen rin po che'i yig char/ bar 'dir bum bskyed spyi ltar gyi cho gas bsgrubs nas/ rjes gnang gi skabs/ sku bskyed bstim gyi rjes dbang lha spyan drang*/ dbang bskur spyi ltar la/ rigs bdag shākya thub pas rgyas gdab par mdzad snang ngo*/ /de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas/ me tog bkye bsdu sogs grub rjes/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal btab/ skabs su gang babs kyi bshad pa ci rigs pas dad pa dang nges shes la sogs pa'i blo bskyed la/ 'dir gnam lcags khyung nag nam mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil pa'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/

slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub nas khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ thog mar slob dpon la khro bo'i dbang po mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil pa dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su sogs nas stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje khyung la sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par mos pa byas la/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas/ 'grub par shog lan gsum/ zhes rgyud dag par byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs nas/ bdag la rdo rje nam mkha' lding gi sku sogs spyi dang 'dra/ zhes pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la/ sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas ham/ zhes brjod pas khyed rang gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gis bsdus pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang las nam mkha'i dkyil du sogs nas/ bzhugs par gyur gyi bar gong bzhin slob ma lhar bskyed nas/ slob dpon la yang khyed rang gis bsgoms pa de lta bu dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/

mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas de thams cad kyi rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka nas rdo rje nam mkha' lding gi sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam/ tshad med/ grangs med/ dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te khyed rang gi lus la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces rol mo bya zhing gu gul gyis bdug sngags kyi mthar oṃ badzra ā we sha ya aḥ.āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas rdo rje nam mkha' lding gi sku'i rjes gnang thob/ lus kyi bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ lus rdo rje khyung gi sku dang dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang gi thugs kar kṣiṃ sngon po gsal btab ste/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags phreng gnyis pa mar me gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung ste zhal nas thon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon la thim par mos la/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la rtsa sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byed du bcug de ltar byas pas dang pos sogs spyi dang 'dra/ slob dpon la drin lan spyi dang 'dra/ mthar rdo rje slob ma 'di'i rgyud la rdo rje khyung gi byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig des rdo rje khyung gi gsung gi sogs gong dang 'dra/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ dngos po med pa sogs nas med pa'o// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don khyed rang lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par snang tsam/ rang bzhin med par me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu de nyid la yid cher gtad pa la brten nas/ lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bu'i tshul du stem gyis zhu ste/

thugs ka'i sa bon la thim zhing*/ de yang je chung je phrar gyur nas nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du rang yal du yal gyis yal ba la brten nas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i nam mkha'i mtshan nyid can rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spro na me tog gtor/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs nas/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod/ des rdo rje khyung gi thugs kyi rjes gnang thob/ sems kyi bar chad sogs rigs 'gre/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ zhes brda sprad/ sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa bla ma dpal ldan grags kyis mdzad pa'i lung bya/ de nas khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung bsdom bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs/ gtang rag tu maṇḍal phul/ lus longs spyod dang bcas pa phul na cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas/ deng nas sogs/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ dngos grub blang*/ bzod par gsol te gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus nas dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis bya'o// de ltar khro rgyal mkha' lding gi /sgrub thabs rjes gnang cho gar bcas// mkhyen ldan a gnyan dus 'khor bas// bskul nas buddha lakṣ+mīs sbyar// nongs pa bshags shing 'bad pa'i dges// 'gro ba'i nad gdon nyer 'tshe'i tshogs// 'joms pa'i mthu ldan stobs bcu pa'i// nyi ma srid 'dir gsal gyur cig /bsnyen sgrub las tshogs kyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don sgrub tshul sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa'i yi ge rnying pa las shes par bya'o// bkra shis// ༈ /khyung nag gi gtor ma'i gsal byed bzhugs/ khyung gi changs bu 'bul ba'i mtshams sgrub thabs su gsal ba bzhin la/ changs bu oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/

rgyas par na mdun gyi nam mkhar yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sogs nas spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i steng du bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar rang nyid dang bdag ces pa'i tshig bzhag pa tsam ma gtogs gong bzhin brjod/ bsdu na rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu bsgom/ gtor sngags rtsa sngags kyis chog oṃ pakṣiṃ rā dza arghaṃ rā dza arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'byung lnga'i mdog can sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje khyung gis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi klu gnyan sa bdag sogs kyi nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de nas nam mkha'i khyung rang la bstim nas bzlas pa bya ba nyid do// bzlas pa'i mjug tu'ang gsol ba de ltar btab/ rang nyid rdo rje khyung du gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ sogs dang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /khro bo'i rgyal po 'grub gyur nas// sogs bsngo ba smon lam bya'o// thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i rtsis zin par bya'o// zhes pa 'di yang the tshom dris byung ba bsal ba'i ched du dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bris pa'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /gser chos khyung gi brgyud 'debs bzhugs so// rdo rje 'chang dang shes rab gsang ba'i zhabs// brtse chen kun snying rje btsun sku mched dang*// rong mi grags pa dpal dang sangs rgyas shrī// gsol ba 'debs so nus mthu'i dngos grub stsol// dar ma grags dang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhabs// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan grags pa'i mtshan// grags pa dpal mgon nam mkha' lhun bzang la// gsol ba 'debs so nus= /shrī mān kīrti dkon mchog rgya mtsho dang*// bsod nams chos 'phel ngag dbang chos kyi grags// rgyal rtse ba dang sangs rgyas dpal bzang la// gsol ba 'debs so= /sangs rgyas phun tshogs bstan 'dzin lhun grub dang*// dpal ldan chos skyong rin chen mchog grub zhabs// rigs kun khyab bdag rin chen chos mdzad la// gsol ba 'debs so=

/yongs 'dzin mes po'i ral pa las 'ongs pa'i// gser chos gaṅgā dad spro'i hub gcig gis// myong ba'i skal bzang srid na dpe med pas// sgo gsum lha sngags ye shes gzi 'bar shog /bsnyen sgrub rnam par dag byas las kyi tshogs// nyam thag 'gro ba'i ched du legs bsgrubs pas// gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i 'og gdon kun bcom zhing*// gnyis med ye shes khro rgyal mngon gyur shog /ces pa 'di'ang rgyal khams kyi sprang ban 'khyams po wā gind+ra su siddhis shrī e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
